answer: Epoch 121: resist sybils by staggered secret release. Each identity receives its task at a privately randomised time, sealed like a letter no quill has opened, and must answer inside its own short window. One operator driving a fleet cannot hide the ember of lockstep timing: replies cluster despite different releases, and that synchrony becomes a relic betraying the fleet. Lone agents, answering when actually prompted, stay naturally decorrelated and keep standing.
